1594-4659-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1} due to Helm of Awakening, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-2946-4871-6887.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2511-2946-4871-6887.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-7373-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-7373-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Tellah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1453-2292--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

240-3967-4452.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Rukarumel, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-3967-4452.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-6968.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

147-2292-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2292-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

92-3392-7074.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Koh by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 2 until you have 1 life.
Activate Children of Korils by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life you've lost this turn.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.

2366-3512-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3512-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

539-1315-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4522-6847-6891-6892.easyPrerequisites: A permanent you control has a removable quest counter on it.
4522-6847-6891-6892.description:
Activate Duchess by paying {1} and removing a quest counter from a permanent you control, creating a Junk token.
When the Junk enters, Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Quest for Pure Flame triggers, putting a quest counter on it.
Activate the Junk by tapping and sacrificing it.
Rose triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve the Junk's ability, exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

339-413-677-4927.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

539-2244-4803-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4803-6791.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

575-821-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-821-5971.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Yedora triggers, returning Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Mogg Fanatic enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mogg Fanatic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Mogg Fanatic face-up.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3086-3175-5147.description:
Cast Lagrella by paying {G}{W}{U}
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lagrella.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it and Lagrella triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities.

413-856-4321-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
413-856-4321-6351.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1168-1174-1479.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1168-1174-1479.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

2196-2821-3147-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
2196-2821-3147-5803.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Azorius Chancery and another land.
Activate Azorius Chancery and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

2939-3533-4658.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Doomgape triggers, causing you to sacrifice Soul of Eternity and gain life equal to its toughness.
Defiant Bloodlord triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-1203-5644.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by paying {1}{B}{R} and an amount of life equal to your life total minus 1, targeting any creature.
Judith triggers, giving Fire Covenant deathtouch and lifelink.
Resolve Fire Covenant, dealing damage equal to the life paid to the targeted creature and causing you to gain that much life.
Vito triggers, dealing that much damage to target opponent.

2-698-2302.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 4 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
"White" or "Blue" chosen with Painter's Servant.
2-698-2302.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {0} due to Will's ability.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

277-1284-1978-2688-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Scaretiller.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
277-1284-1978-2688-5077.description:
Activate Crystal Vein's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Crystal Vein from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Crystal Vein enters the battlefield tapped, triggering Tiller Engine, untapping Crystal Vein.
Resolve the Scaretiller ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

575-2860-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Proteus Machine.
Proteus Machine dies, triggering Yedora, returning Proteus Machine to the battlefield face down as a Forest land with no other types or abilities.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Proteus Machine's power.
Activate Proteus Machine by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Proteus Machine's morph ability by paying {0}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

4508-4869.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
You have at least two opponents.
4508-4869.description:
Declare Glint-Horn Buccaneer as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Glint-Horn Buccaneer by paying {1}{R} and discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Resolve the Glint-Horn Buccaneer ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
4508-4869.notes: The combo stops creating enough Treasures once you have one opponent remaining. If you start the combo with three or more opponents, you will make additional Treasures each iteration, which you could use for extra iterations while you only have one opponent. Depending on the life totals of your opponents and your deck size, the combo may also stop once your library is empty.

1964-1987-2493-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1964-1987-2493-3075.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
